scientific_integrity: Algebraic equivalence plus strict descent establishes the universal claim; finite programmatic scan only checks examples. The first base-3 point is explicitly attributed to the source, with no claim of its discovery. Unchecked wider literature and later journal differences are recorded as originality risks.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed points with one signed real base digit and a nonzero signed constant imaginary repdigit of any length are classified. The Pell equation is classical. Other nonreal fixed points and nontrivial cycles are not classified. Separate full text of the 2022 journal version and survey was inaccessible; their abstracts and the complete 2021 open preprint were checked.
title: Repdigit rigidity and a Pell spectrum of Gaussian digit-square fixed points
